scope: technical hypotheses for future evidence collection; no parser fix authorized

hypotheses.description: The local accumulated entity index may diverge from intended stream entity index because previous index, indexDelta read, or cursor position is wrong.
evidenceFor: Missing UPDATE target appears after accumulated index arithmetic.
Task 122 observed a large local index jump in replay_010 packet 954.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 reported packet 954 read counts within entityData and no packet-953-like boundary signs.
The same arithmetic is used broadly for PacketEntities and is not proven wrong by current compact evidence.
confirmingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger shows monotonic/local index sequence discontinuity immediately before first missing UPDATE.
Synthetic/local cursor replay from the same compact metadata decodes an implausible indexDelta or entityIndex at the boundary.
refutingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger shows coherent prior entity sequence and no abnormal indexDelta/read-count signature.
Target had prior CREATE/register evidence and missing state is better explained by registry lifecycle.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Changing index accumulation would affect every PacketEntities entry and could corrupt otherwise valid entity state.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Use existing replay-wide ledger on authorized canaries to compare indexDelta, previousEntityIndex, readCounts, and target lifecycle before any code change.

hypotheses.description: The local cursor may read the wrong two bits as command, making an entry look like UPDATE when stream intent was different.
evidenceFor: Prior packet-953 work showed cursor/boundary artifacts can create phantom entries.
Command decode depends directly on the cursor after variable-length index read.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 did not find packet-954 boundary/trailing signs comparable to packet 953.
Both canaries fail at bounded UPDATE entries, but no current evidence proves command bits are misread.
confirmingCompactData: Boundary diagnostic shows read count at or beyond entityDataBitLength before/after index or command.
Nearby offset probes decode plausible non-UPDATE operation with better consistency metrics.
refutingCompactData: Read counts are in bounds and nearby offset probes do not improve consistency.
Replay-wide ledger shows target lifecycle contradiction independent of cursor position.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Changing command decode or cursor alignment without proof could mask real fail-fast boundaries and introduce silent state drift.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Keep fail-closed and compare compact read-count/nearby-offset diagnostics only if explicitly authorized.

hypotheses.description: A CREATE may be decoded but not registered because the parser takes a path that emits an event or fails before registerEntity.
evidenceFor: CREATE registration is not unconditional; class/baseline/entity-constructor failures can happen before register.
Event mode defers registration until later event application.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 saw no CREATE/register/class/baseline attempt for entity 2905 before its missing UPDATE.
No committed evidence currently shows an event queue registration loss for the failing targets.
confirmingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger records CREATE for the target with registerEntityAttempted=false or registerEntitySucceeded=false before missing UPDATE.
FailureStage indicates class_lookup, baseline_lookup, entity_constructor, or event application gap.
refutingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger records no target CREATE at all before first missing UPDATE.
Ledger records successful registerEntity followed by later DELETE/LEAVE or registry loss evidence.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Registering entities earlier could materialize unsupported state, bypass baseline invariants, or create fake fields.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Use the Task 141 ledger fields classLookupAttempted, baselineLookupAttempted, registerEntityAttempted, and registerEntitySucceeded.

hypotheses.description: The target entity may have been registered earlier but removed from local registry or overwritten before a later UPDATE.
evidenceFor: Demo.registerEntity overwrites prior entity at the same index.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 did not observe prior create/register/removal for entity 2905.
Packet-local probes for 010/011 had replayWideHistoryKnown=false before Task 141.
confirmingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger records prior register success for target, then a DELETE, overwrite, or missing registry state before missing UPDATE.
Serial/generation metadata changes for same index before boundary.
refutingCompactData: No prior target event appears in replay-wide ledger despite many tracked compact events.
Prior target events show no registry removal and registry remains present until boundary.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Assuming registry loss could lead to reintroducing stale entities or ignoring legitimate fail-fast errors.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Run only an authorized fail-closed ledger pass and inspect compact target events before boundary.

hypotheses.description: Local DELETE/LEAVE handling may not capture game/entity lifecycle semantics needed to interpret a later UPDATE for an inactive or missing entity.
evidenceFor: LEAVE deactivates but preserves registry slot; DELETE removes registry slot.
A later UPDATE activates inactive entities but cannot update missing registry slots.
evidenceAgainst: No prior DELETE/LEAVE for target has been observed in replay-wide real canary evidence yet.
Registry absence alone cannot prove delete/leave/destruction semantics.
confirmingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger records target DELETE or LEAVE before missing UPDATE.
Boundary summary distinguishes present_inactive from missing.
refutingCompactData: Target was never observed in local parser history before missing UPDATE.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Treating missing UPDATE as tolerated post-delete/leave could hide cursor issues or invent lifecycle semantics.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Preserve strict fail-closed behavior while collecting removal-like operation history.

hypotheses.description: A CREATE for the target may fail before registration due to class lookup, baseline lookup, or entity construction.
evidenceFor: CREATE performs class lookup, Entity constructor, and baseline lookup before direct registration in the allowed path.
Existing diagnostics already record class/baseline/register booleans.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 reported no class or baseline lookup attempt for entity 2905 before first missing UPDATE.
This hypothesis requires a prior CREATE-like entry for the target that current compact evidence has not shown.
confirmingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger records target CREATE with failureStage class_lookup, entity_constructor, or baseline_lookup.
registerEntityAttempted=false with class/baseline failure before missing UPDATE.
refutingCompactData: Target CREATE succeeded and registerEntitySucceeded=true before a later registry loss.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Skipping class/baseline failures or registering without baseline would create unsupported entity state.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Use compact CREATE failureStage and register booleans; do not add recovery.

hypotheses.description: serializedEntities payloadBits may be misunderstood as a safe direct cursor boundary or skip contract.
evidenceFor: Task 116/117 showed payloadBits boundaries did not explain packet-953 field reader consumption.
Recovery/filter paths can move by payloadBits, making contract clarity important.
evidenceAgainst: Task 121/122 reported packet 954 did not show comparable boundary signs.
Normal unfiltered field parsing does not rely on payloadBits for cursor advancement.
confirmingCompactData: Boundary packet shows payloadBits/actual read count mismatch immediately before missing UPDATE.
Payload iterator cardinality or cumulative boundaries diverge in the failure packet.
refutingCompactData: PayloadBits and actual after-action read counts align across nearby entries.
Missing UPDATE occurs without payloadBits/cursor anomaly.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Using payloadBits as a universal skip boundary could silently skip valid field data or phantom entries.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Treat payloadBits as diagnostic evidence unless a future task proves a bounded contract.

hypotheses.description: The observed pattern could reflect Source 2/Deadlock PacketEntities semantics not represented in the local parser contract.
filesAndFunctions: local parser contract only; no external runtime oracle currently available
evidenceFor: Same missing entity class repeated across replay_010 and replay_011.
Clarity runtime was unavailable and no external oracle has confirmed or contradicted local behavior.
evidenceAgainst: Prior art static review did not find a confirmed implicit-create-on-update behavior.
No evidence currently validates a semantic exception.
confirmingCompactData: External oracle or documented prior art shows bounded handling for UPDATE to absent local entity in Deadlock/Source 2.
Multiple authorized human canaries show same local failure with coherent local cursor and no registry/history explanation.
refutingCompactData: Replay-wide ledger identifies a local parser lifecycle or cursor cause.
External oracle reproduces equivalent fail-fast error.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Implementing assumed Source semantics would convert uncertainty into parser behavior without evidence.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Keep semantic claims forbidden; collect local compact evidence first, and revisit oracle only if manually available.

evidenceFor: Task 141 ledger is only synthetically validated and has not been run on replay_010 or replay_011.
evidenceAgainst: Parser mechanism is now mapped enough to define precise compact evidence needs.
Existing probes already rule out some broad claims such as packet-953 truncation resolving entity 2905.
confirmingCompactData: Future ledger pass still yields conflicting or absent target history with no cursor/payload anomaly.
No external oracle or static prior art resolves the contract.
refutingCompactData: Future ledger pass yields a clear allowed diagnostic candidate such as created_then_missing_registry_state_candidate or index_stream_or_cursor_contract_suspected.
hypotheses.prematureFixRisk: Any fix before evidence selection risks solving the wrong mechanism and hiding the fail-closed signal.
hypotheses.safeNextAction: Authorize one bounded fail-closed real-canary ledger run, not a recovery or fix.
